subject: Re: AI Summit APAC — BrightOps joint track + pre-summit webinar
messages:
From: BrightOps Partnerships <hello@brightops.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jason Miller <j.miller@ai-summit.org>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AI Summit APAC — BrightOps x Redwood joint track idea

Hi Priyom,

Hope all's well — I'm Neha from BrightOps partnerships. We're planning our presence at AI Summit APAC (Sept 2026) and would love to explore a joint track with Redwood focused on "Scaling LLMs in Regulated Environments".

High-level ideas:
- 45-min panel (BrightOps customer + Redwood engineer + consultancy)
- Pre-summit 60-min webinar to drive registrations and produce a co-branded case study
- Shared booth hours for two days + a mini-demo slot each afternoon

Would Redwood be open to co-sponsoring the panel + running a pre-summit webinar? We can cover a portion of booth costs and handle conference logistics. Happy to share rough numbers and a draft agenda.

Attaching a short sponsorship pack and our logo set.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, BrightOps
Attachments: BrightOps_sponsorship_pack.pdf (pdf), BrightOps_logos.zip (zip)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>
To: BrightOps Partnerships <hello@brightops.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AI Summit APAC — BrightOps x Redwood joint track idea

Hi Neha — thanks for the note and the pack. Excited by the fit.

Quick answers up front: yes to a shared panel and pre-summit webinar; yes to a co-branded case study if we can align on customer permissioning. We'd prefer the panel to be more technical (ops-focused) than a product demo — think deployment patterns, observability, cost controls.

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) Draft agenda for panel + webinar (we'll propose speakers)
2) SOW outline and cost split for booth (finance will need this)
3) Confirm customer(s) who can speak; if BrightOps has a willing customer, we'll coordinate NDA/permissions

Karthik and Grace are looped to scope the technical angle. Can we do a quick 30-min sync next week? I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — priyom@redwood.inference.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AI Summit APAC — BrightOps x Redwood joint track idea

Team — forwarding BrightOps outreach. Quick notes before the sync:

- Goal: secure a co-branded panel + pre-event webinar to generate qualified leads and a case study.
- Audience: platform/infra engineers at mid-enterprise APAC customers (EHR, fintech).
- Redwood asks: speaking slot for an engineer (Karthik?), marketing support (webinar comms), half-booth cost (we cover 50%), and a 1-pager co-branded case study post-event.

Specific asks for the meeting:
- Karthik: draft 3 topic bullets (ops-focused) you could present
- Grace: what CS/customer(s) we can approach for the case study (2 candidates)
- Camila: marketing brief — audience, comm cadence, quick CTA copy for joint registration
- Soojin: legal quick-take — any obvious procurement/SOW red flags for APAC events (visa, tax, vendor terms)

I'll book a 30-min slot for Monday 8th. If you can't make it, send notes back here.

Thanks — Priyom

From: BrightOps Partnerships <hello@brightops.ai>

Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 16:45:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: AI Summit APAC — BrightOps x Redwood joint track idea

Hi all — great to have you engaged. Thanks Priyom for outlining asks. Quick responses:

- Agenda: attached a draft (draft_agenda_v1.pdf) with proposed speakers. We put Karthik down for a 12-min "Operationalizing LLMs" slot within the panel.
- Booth: BrightOps can cover 60% of the booth fee; Redwood 40% (we can invoice per GA line items).
- Webinar: propose July 28 (60 min) — BrightOps to own registration page, Redwood to own half the comm list and provide an engineer and a CS speaker.
- Customer speaker: BrightOps has consent from one customer (MediTrust APAC) pending a quick permissions email.

Attachments: draft_agenda_v1.pdf, BrightOps_logos.zip.

Please review agenda and confirm: speaker names, invoicing contact (finance@redwood.inference.com?), and whether you want a shared pre-event press blurb.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
BrightOps Partnerships

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>

All — thanks for the fast turnaround and the agenda. Notes and actions from our side:

- Karthik: confirmed for the panel; please refine your 12-min talking points to include 2 concrete deployment patterns and one note on observability metrics.
- Grace: prep outreach to MediTrust and our two internal candidate customers (CloudHealth Systems, FinEdge). Ask for speaker permission and any compliance redlines.
- Camila: draft the webinar landing page copy and 3-email nurture sequence; include a CTA to schedule a 15-min technical consult.
- Soojin: please review the attached SOW draft and check APAC vendor terms; flag any insurance/VAT issues.

Finance contact is finance@redwood.inference.com — please send SOW to them with cost breakdown. I'll set up a shared Drive folder and drop the SOW and logos there: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B_example_agenda

Let's aim to finalize speaker list + SOW by June 18 so CloudWorks and AI Summit can promote the track.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
